title: Where to Eat After Your Ride
why: Local spotlight: sends riders to six nearby businesses open into November; @mentions notify them and invite reshares.
hook_options: Where to eat after your ride.
Ride first. Then lobster, beer or pie.
Six spots that stay open after summer.
caption: Ride first, eat second. Six Door County spots that stay open this fall, all an easy drive from our Jacksonport shop: @islandfeverjport, @doorcountybrewingco, @harborfishmarketbh, @doorcountycoffee, @scaturos and @doorpeninsulawinery. Nobody paid us for this list. Hours shift after October, so check their pages before you go. #DoorCounty #Jacksonport #BaileysHarbor #DoorCountyEats

slides.headline: Island Fever, right down the road.
slides.body: @islandfeverjport in Jacksonport. Seafood, hand-cut steaks and a tiki bar. Closed Tuesdays.

slides.headline: Door County Brewing in Baileys Harbor.
slides.body: @doorcountybrewingco. The taproom is open year round, with a dog friendly beer garden. Check winter hours first.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-Point-Bike-Rental-Jac.jpg

slides.headline: Harbor Fish Market and Grille.
slides.body: @harborfishmarketbh. Live Maine lobster and fresh oysters in an old building on the harbor. Days vary, so call ahead.

slides.headline: Coffee straight from the roaster.
slides.body: @doorcountycoffee in Carlsville, roasting since 1993. Cafe and drive-thru open 7:30 to 4, seven days a week.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-Point-County-Park-Bike-Rental.jpg

slides.headline: Scaturo's in Sturgeon Bay.
slides.body: @scaturos. Pecan rolls and cherry pies made with real Door County cherries. Opens at 5am, 7am Sundays.

slides.headline: Door Peninsula Winery in Carlsville.
slides.body: @doorpeninsulawinery has made fruit wine since 1974. Door County Distillery shares the building.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-point-county-park-electric-bike-rental-2.jpg

slides.headline: Hours change fast after October.
slides.body: Everything here was listed as open into November when we checked. Look at their pages before you drive over.

slides.headline: Ride first. Then lobster, beer or pie.
slides.body: Jacksonport, Baileys Harbor, Carlsville and Sturgeon Bay. All an easy drive from the shop.

slides.kicker: Save this for your Door County weekend
slides.headline: Six stops. One ride first.
slides.body: E-bike rentals at doorcountykayaktours.com. Tag whoever's buying lunch.
